data.name: AlFalak
data.gender_notes: AlFalak is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: AlFalak is derived from the Arabic word ‘al-falak’ meaning ‘the swallow’. In Islamic tradition, the swallow is a symbol of hope and good omen. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) mentioned that the swallow is a sign of Paradise. The name AlFalak carries the meaning “The Swallow” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlFalak usually hope their child will grow to embody the swallow and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of hope and a good omen in Islamic tradition.
data.etymology: AlFalak belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Swallow.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlFalak total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
